📢 WALK-IN INTERVIEW | GOA UNIVERSITY

Goa University is conducting a walk-in interview for the position of Project Assistant under the Goa University IPR Scheme 2025–26 for the project titled “MathBhi: An AI-Enhanced Platform for Step-by-Step Learning in Higher Mathematics.”

📍 Location: Goa University, Taleigao Plateau, Goa

Position: Project Assistant
Vacancies: 1
Qualification: M.Sc. in Mathematics with 55% marks or equivalent CGPA
Desirable: Experience in Python coding
Salary: ₹11,000 per month
Duration: 3 months

📅 Interview Date: 22 October 2026
⏰ Time: 3:00 PM
📌 Venue: Seminar Room, Discipline of Mathematics, School of Physical and Applied Sciences (SPAS), Goa University.

Instructions: Candidates must bring their original certificates and bio-data. Please arrive at least 30 minutes before the scheduled time. No TA/DA will be provided.

📞 For Details: 8861010765
📧 chitra@unigoa.ac.in
